paragraphs: Some people make someone's whole life brighter simply by being a roommate. If it hadn't been you, I would never have seen my life — or myself — the way I do today.
No amount of sweet words could ever be enough to describe how lucky I am to have crossed paths with you, and to have you as a friend and roommate.
I don't know what good plans life still holds for me, but I can guarantee this: the last ten seconds of my life will revolve around the memories we made in our room at KIIT.
finalLines: No matter where life takes us…
Thank you for being part of my life.
message.secret: You found the tiny heart. Here is the secret: every version of my favorite memories has you somewhere inside it.
message.puzzleComplete: Piece by piece, you make life more beautiful.

reasons: How you make people feel seen

compliments.text: You make kindness look like a superpower.
Your presence turns ordinary moments into favorite memories.
You have the rarest kind of beauty—the kind people can feel.
The world is genuinely lovelier with your laugh in it.
You are becoming everything your younger self hoped for.
Your heart is a safe place, and that is extraordinary.
You shine without ever needing to outshine anyone.
Knowing you is one of life's quiet gifts.
